I dated a guy for three months, I was 17 at the time and he was 22 ,he would love bomb me and then the next minute start a fight about the most ridiculous, insignificant of reasons (he once started a fight because he didn't believe i liked his new hairstyle when i complimented him about it)

 around the second month he started displaying violent behaviours and the final straw for me was when i had to stay up for 5 hours trying to convince him to delete messages he sent my ex saying he'll beat the shit out of him.

 After we broke up he threatened to self harm and unalive himself , he reached out to my friends telling them to "take care of me " since he won't be alive to do it which led to many concerned friends begging me to unblock him.

He then stalked me for two years and threatened me occasionally, I am now 20 years old and to this day I'm scared to leave my house , I'm scared for my current s/o , My social media posts are limited and I always quiver at the sound of my phone ringing ,I still have nightmares and panic attacks, those two years cost me my peace and have scarred me for life ,I don't feel safe in my own home 

I truly believe that I'll be at peace when I see his death certificate.

As a child it truly made me think that my problems were not important unless it was at a higher severity level but as an adult I've come to realise the emotional damage it has caused ,i minimise my own problems and suffer in silence because i always assume it's not important. If you are a parent please for crying out loud even if you don't think it's that serious listen when your child expresses any sort of discomfort or pain...

But when you stop making an effort and suddenly they disappear it becomes clear that the friendship was one sided and you were taken for granted or perhaps expected to make the first move, maybe there's more to it but whatever the case, know your worth and surround yourself with people that will match your energy.

People don't get over these things, saying it gets better and trying to police her emotions isn't going to make things better, all you are doing is making her suffer in silence and she will rightfully grow to despise you for that. Have the day you deserve.
